name: Akram Zakine
tagline: Mathematician · IMC 2026 world #3 · IMO 2024 silver medalist
bioShort: Mathematics student at the École Normale Supérieure (PSL, Paris). Problem solver — olympiads, algorithms, and the geometry in between.
bioLong: Akram Zakine studies mathematics at the École Normale Supérieure (PSL), Paris, after two years of classes préparatoires at Lycée Louis-le-Grand and his secondary education at Athénée Robert Catteau in Brussels. He placed 3rd worldwide at the 2026 International Mathematics Competition (Math&Maroc team), is a two-time Moroccan national champion (MMC 2025, 2026), a two-time Belgian national champion (OMB 2023, 2024), an IMO 2024 silver medalist, and represented Belgium at IOI 2024. Beyond competitions he is drawn to computer science — algorithms, computer vision, and AI — wherever it meets mathematics.
